_comment.num_inference_steps: S=10 from the RePIC paper and the original LIBERO policy setup.
_comment.picard_window: Picard window p=10 from the RePIC paper.
_comment.picard_tol: Picard tolerance tau=0.05 from the RePIC paper.
_comment.r_max: Original LIBERO OpenPI replan_steps=5; this is the fixed Rmax.
_comment.dynamic_replan_enabled: False because Rmax=Rmin=H/2 for pi0.5 LIBERO (H=10).
_comment.dynamic_replan_log_mean: Log-normal mu from RePIC Eq. 8; unused while dynamic replan is disabled.
_comment.dynamic_replan_log_std: Log-normal s from RePIC Eq. 8; unused while dynamic replan is disabled.
